cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(multiapp CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Conan-provided dependencies (asio, gtest)
# Generated by `conan install .` (CMakeDeps + CMakeToolchain).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
find_package(asio REQUIRED)
find_package(GTest REQUIRED)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# System dependencies: gtkmm-4.0 and webkitgtk-6.0 are not in ConanCenter,
# so they come from the OS via pkg-config.
#   Arch:   sudo pacman -S gtkmm-4.0 webkitgtk-6.0
#   Debian: sudo apt install libgtkmm-4.0-dev libwebkitgtk-6.0-dev
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(GTKMM  REQUIRED gtkmm-4.0)
pkg_check_modules(WEBKIT REQUIRED webkitgtk-6.0)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Core library: all apps + the application shell
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_library(multiapp_core STATIC
    src/main_application.cc
    src/browser_app.cc
    src/fractal_app.cc
    src/chat_app.cc
    src/session.cc)
target_include_directories(multiapp_core PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    ${GTKMM_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${WEBKIT_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_directories(multiapp_core PUBLIC ${GTKMM_LIBRARY_DIRS} ${WEBKIT_LIBRARY_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(multiapp_core PUBLIC
    ${GTKMM_LIBRARIES} ${WEBKIT_LIBRARIES}
    asio::asio
    z)
target_compile_options(multiapp_core PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main executable
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_executable(multiapp src/main.cc)
target_link_libraries(multiapp PRIVATE multiapp_core)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tests (GoogleTest)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
enable_testing()
add_executable(multiapp_tests
    tests/main.cc
    tests/main_application_tests.cc
    tests/browser_app_tests.cc
    tests/fractal_app_tests.cc
    tests/chat_app_tests.cc)
target_link_libraries(multiapp_tests PRIVATE multiapp_core GTest::gtest_main)
include(GoogleTest)
gtest_discover_tests(multiapp_tests)
